extras: Requires disabling 'Auto convert HTML' in Editor settings before pasting AI answers.
problem: Formulas copied directly from AI responses often fail to render correctly within Obsidian notes.

relations.evidence: Forked from xixia123/obsidian-transfer-latex-from-gpt by Xixia, with thanks.

summary: A tool that converts LaTeX formulas copied from AI chat outputs into Obsidian-compatible MathJax syntax using a single command.
